::: {.lede}
Alongside academic research, I lead and contribute to studies commissioned by government agencies, mostly in Bihar. Before joining the faculty I spent eight months inside government as a Research Associate with the State Transformation Cell of the State Support Mission (NITI Aayog) in Patna.
:::
